title: Introducing yourself at a party
objectives: Introduce yourself and respond to the greeting
Explain how you know the host
Build on the connection with a follow-up question

courseTemplate.setting: Laura is the host. The learner works with Laura and recently moved from Shanghai.

roles.learner: A guest meeting a friend of Laura's

courseTemplate.openingLine: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Sam.

targetPatterns.pattern: I'm Chen. Nice to meet you.
targetPatterns.example: I'm Chen. Nice to meet you.

targetPatterns.pattern: We work together. I recently moved here from Shanghai.
targetPatterns.example: We work together. I recently moved here from Shanghai.

targetPatterns.pattern: I'm glad you liked it! What was your favourite thing to eat there?
targetPatterns.example: I'm glad you liked it! What was your favourite thing to eat there?

targetPatterns.pattern: I'm Chen — nice to meet you.
targetPatterns.example: I'm Chen — nice to meet you.
targetPatterns.translation: 我是小陈，很高兴认识你。

targetPatterns.pattern: I work as a UX designer for a startup.
targetPatterns.example: I work as a UX designer for a startup.
targetPatterns.translation: 我在一家创业公司做用户体验设计。

targetPatterns.pattern: I'm originally from Chengdu, but I live here now.
targetPatterns.example: I'm originally from Chengdu, but I live here now.
targetPatterns.translation: 我来自成都，现在住这儿。

targetPatterns.pattern: I'm here for a language exchange.
targetPatterns.example: I'm here for a language exchange.
targetPatterns.translation: 我是来参加语言交换的。

targetPatterns.pattern: What about you — what do you do?
targetPatterns.example: What about you — what do you do?

targetPatterns.pattern: That's a cool job — how did you get into it?
targetPatterns.example: That's a cool job — how did you get into it?
targetPatterns.translation: 这工作挺酷的，你怎么入行的？

targetPatterns.pattern: I've been learning English for two years.
targetPatterns.example: I've been learning English for two years.

targetPatterns.pattern: Add me on Instagram — same as my name.
targetPatterns.example: Add me on Instagram — same as my name.

stages.title: Introduce yourself and respond to the greeting
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Sam.”
successCriteria: The learner can introduce yourself and respond to the greeting in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I'm Chen. Nice to …”

stages.title: Explain how you know the host
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Nice to meet you too. How do you know Laura?”
successCriteria: The learner can explain how you know the host in their own words.
hints: You can start with “We work together. I …”

stages.title: Build on the connection with a follow-up question
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “I visited Shanghai last spring. The food was amazing.”
successCriteria: The learner can build on the connection with a follow-up question in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I'm glad you liked …”

languageNotes: 中国姓氏中文顺序直译（如 "I'm Wang Li"）易被误解，介绍时说 I'm Li — call me Li 更简单；「我是做……的」I work as a...，不说 "My job is a..."。
